questionText:

Reason (R): Bernier believed that because the Mughal emperor owned all land, landholders could not pass land on to their children and therefore had no incentive to invest long-term capital in soil improvement.

options.text: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)

3. Reason (R) directly explains Assertion (A).

topic: Al-Biruni on the Concept of Pollution
questionText:
Read the following excerpt carefully and answer the question that follows:

"Al-Biruni tried to explain the caste system by looking for parallels in other societies. In ancient Persia, he noted four classes: knights and princes; monks and fire-priests; lawyers, physicians, astronomers and other scientists; and peasants and artisans. In other words, he attempted to suggest that social divisions were not unique to India. At the same time, Al-Biruni disapproved of the Brahmanical notion of pollution. He remarked that everything which falls into a state of impurity strives and succeeds in regaining its original condition of purity. The sun cleanses the air, and the salt in the sea prevents the water from becoming foul. If it were not so, insisted Al-Biruni, life on earth would have been impossible.
